4.speaker: Mansoun Leke
4.text: "And they did not harm anyone. Everything has gone incredibly well so far."

6.speaker: Player
6.text: "You are saying that but your eyes speak differently."

7.speaker: Player
7.text: "Thank you for your service, Mr. Leke."

8.speaker: Mansoun Leke
8.text: "Don't mention it. I did this for my people, and for Sordland."

9.speaker: Mansoun Leke
9.text: "I haven't slept in days, Mr. President. And of course, it was tough being around heavily armed men, if that's what you're trying to get at..."

10.speaker: Mansoun Leke
10.text: "They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

11.speaker: Mansoun Leke
11.text: "Apparently, nobody expected you to hold talks with them."

12.speaker: Mansoun Leke
12.text: "But they did release Mr. Bron, didn't they? They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

13.speaker: Mansoun Leke
13.text: "If my service helps with the unity of our people, I would never hesitate to do it."

14.speaker: Mansoun Leke
14.text: "And luckily, the meeting went well. They even released Mr. Bron, saying they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

15.speaker: Player
15.text: "So they gave away their bargaining chip just like that?"

17.speaker: Player
17.text: "What did you tell them to make this happen?"

19.speaker: Mansoun Leke
19.text: "Judging by your previous actions against... us."

20.speaker: Mansoun Leke
20.text: "Yes. They don't want violence. They only want their voices to be heard."

22.speaker: Mansoun Leke
22.text: "I, and the whole delegation only relayed your intentions to find a diplomatic solution."

23.speaker: Mansoun Leke
23.text: "As I said, they took that as a gesture of goodwill."

28.speaker: Mansoun Leke
28.text: "Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, let alone stand with them. I only support the Bludish people."

29.speaker: Mansoun Leke
29.text: "But you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."

30.speaker: Mansoun Leke
30.text: "Because you have left them no choice."

32.speaker: Mansoun Leke
32.text: "Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, nor try to defend them."

33.speaker: Mansoun Leke
33.text: "While I do not support any of their actions, you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."

34.speaker: Mansoun Leke
34.text: "Many in their ranks were young men, probably recruited from the villages in Bergia. They are led to believe the BFF is the only way to make their voices heard."

36.speaker: Mansoun Leke
36.text: "First of all, they want the region of Bergia to be made autonomous. They want the local populace to be able to govern themselves."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "I should have known sending a Blud was a mistake."

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "Everything I've done was out of necessity."

40.speaker: Player
40.text: "So, I'm to blame for this attack?"

47.speaker: Mansoun Leke
47.text: "Our people have suffered a lot through the short history of this republic."

48.speaker: Mansoun Leke
48.text: "Even though this state keeps denying it, all of us know this to be true."

52.speaker: Mansoun Leke
52.text: "And I should have known that you meant none of it. At your speech during the Izzam Anniversary."

53.speaker: Mansoun Leke
53.text: "There is no excuse for oppressing a group of people, Mr. President."

54.speaker: Mansoun Leke
54.text: "I'm just another *Blud* for you, am I not, Mr. President?"

55.speaker: Mansoun Leke
55.text: "You have only fed the stigma and discrimination, reinforcing this vicious cycle."

56.speaker: Player
56.text: "Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me or the armed separatists who attacked our nation's energy source?"

57.speaker: Player
57.text: "I advise you to watch your words, Mr. Leke."

58.speaker: Player
58.text: "Look. I'm doing my best to support the Bludish people."

59.speaker: Mansoun Leke
59.text: "I don't want to be disrespectful, Mr. President. We have an important matter to discuss here."

60.speaker: Mansoun Leke
60.text: "I don't want these meetings to fall flat. Especially not because of me. Please excuse me for my language."

61.speaker: Mansoun Leke
61.text: "Let's try to achieve something for them with this meeting then."

62.speaker: Mansoun Leke
62.text: "I will tell you what the BFF told me."

64.speaker: Mansoun Leke
64.text: "Let's move on to what the BFF demanded."

66.speaker: Mansoun Leke
66.text: "These are their demands. They want the governor dismissed and the Special Zone's current structure to be abolished."

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: He took out a piece of paper and stood up.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: He walked up to me and placed the paper in my hands.

69.speaker: Mansoun Leke
69.text: "They want a local assembly to be formed responsible for all regional affairs of Bergia..."

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: He returned back to the couch and sat down.

71.speaker: Mansoun Leke
71.text: "...which is elected by the residents of the region."

72.speaker: Mansoun Leke
72.text: "They also want the revocation of the ban on the Workers Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party..."

73.speaker: Mansoun Leke
73.text: "They also want the revocation of the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party..."

74.speaker: Mansoun Leke
74.text: "...And the revocation of both the Unified Education Language Act and the Religious Harmony Act..."

84.speaker: Mansoun Leke
84.text: "And the revocation of the Unified Education Language Act..."
84.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true)

85.speaker: Mansoun Leke
85.text: "And the revocation of the Religious Harmony Act..."
85.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true)

86.speaker: Mansoun Leke
86.text: "...as well as amnesty for every Bludish prisoner who was arrested for alleged separatist actions. Including Dewlen Arge."
86.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false)

87.speaker: Player
87.text: "And here I thought we could have a diplomatic solution..."

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: It had been a very long time since I heard that name. He was dubbed "The Bludish Terror" by Tarquin Soll when he led the BFF against the state in 1935.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: Nobody had really spoken of him since his arrest more than 10 years ago.

90.speaker: Player
90.text: "I'll do it. For the sake of peace."

91.speaker: Player
91.text: "There is no way I can accept such demands."

93.speaker: Mansoun Leke
93.text: "So, you'll initiate the attack then? After they released the governor?"

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: Mansoun looked at me as if he was trying to figure out if he understood me correctly.

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: Mansoun looked at me with surprise.

96.speaker: Mansoun Leke
96.text: "So, you'll comply with their demands then?"

97.speaker: Player
97.text: "Yes. I'll write a decree and sign it immediately."
97.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

99.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
99.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true

100.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
100.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

101.speaker: Player
101.text: "Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I don't have the authority to sign such decrees anymore."
101.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true

102.speaker: Player
102.text: "You heard me. I'll give them what they want."
102.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

103.speaker: Player
103.text: "We'll put them in a bill and propose it to the Assembly immediately."
103.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Path"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true

104.speaker: Player
104.text: "Yes. I cannot accept these demands. And we cannot let them destroy the Soll Dam."

110.speaker: Mansoun Leke
110.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "Go ahead and gather the team. I'm counting on you."

112.speaker: Player
112.text: "No. You've done enough. I'll have someone else do it."

113.speaker: Mansoun Leke
113.text: "I hope they listen to you. The Assembly is full of anti-Bludish sentiment."
113.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false)

114.speaker: Mansoun Leke
114.text: "I wouldn't think I'd regret supporting limiting presidential decrees."

116.speaker: Player
116.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false)

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "I can do it except the autonomy."
117.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false)

118.speaker: Player
118.text: "First, they will have to put down their weapons and surrender."
118.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false)

120.speaker: Player
120.text: "They will if they truly desire a diplomatic solution."

122.speaker: Player
122.text: "If they don't, I will have no other choice but to destroy them."

123.speaker: Mansoun Leke
123.text: "This will only result in more death and destruction in Bergia."

154.speaker: Mansoun Leke
154.text: "I'm glad they didn't harm anyone. Everything has gone incredibly well so far."

161.speaker: Mansoun Leke
161.text: "But they did release Mr. Krull, didn't they? They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

168.speaker: Mansoun Leke
168.text: "And luckily, the meeting went well. They even released Mr. Krull, saying they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

179.speaker: Mansoun Leke
179.text: "These are their demands. They want the centralization of Bergia to be cancelled and the Interior's control over the region to be taken away."
